about: The masks a record of pi's --mode json / --mode rpc output passes before it is compared with amiga-pi's: read by tests/test_pi_modes.c and by vtcon's tools/rig/amigapi_rig.py (mask_rpc), the one list of both. Each mask has its reason here and a COMPATIBILITY.md row (group pi-modes).

star.durationMs: pi 1.1.0: ms measured per run (a message's request time, a tool's execute() time); the key and its place are compared, the value is not
star.sessionFile: pi names session files by time and uuid, ours by the session's own naming
star.sections: the system prompt is compared where it lives (test_pi_store, test_pi_resources); its text is amiga-pi's
star.estimatedTokensAfter: counts the compacted context with its system message, whose text is amiga-pi's prompt

ids.why: a uuid or an 8-hex entry id is made per run; the fixed ids of the session fixtures start d000 and are compared

rules.cost.total: the sum: pi adds binary floats (0.0036149999999999997), ours prints decimal micro-dollars; the four parts are compared
rules.errorMessage of an HTTP error: pi: status and the raw body (`400 {...}`, the SDK's APIError text), ours `HTTP 400: <message>`; the value is masked, the key and its place are compared
rules.tokensBefore of an overflow compaction t: the failed answer was omitted first (a context_edit), so pi counts the context by estimate alone (compaction.ts estimateProjectedContextTokens), the system message included, whose text is amiga-pi's prompt (as estimatedTokensAfter: both differ by the same 273 tokens in overflow); a silent overflow (willRetry false), a threshold or a manual compaction is usage-based and compared
rules.message_start usage and responseId: pi serializes the shared partial message when its consumer runs: the first counts and the response id (both set by the stream's message_start event) are in or not from run to run of pi itself
rules.get_commands rows of pi's built-in exten: pi lists `mcp` and `llama` (sourceInfo.source builtin) after the extension commands; amiga-pi has no such commands (COMPATIBILITY.md, extensions); the rows are left out on both sides
rules.extension file suffix: a scenario's extension is t.ts (or a.ts, dirx/index.ts) for pi and t.lua here; in a path under /extensions/ the suffix .ts or .lua is compared as .<ext>
rules.get_available_models: compared for the fixture's provider only (the catalog's plain-http providers are available here without a key)
